name: Camping-Stadler
beschreibung: Camping-Stadler is located on the shores of Lake Waginger See in the Upper Bavarian Alpine foothills, approximately 20 kilometers west of Traunstein. The campsite features direct lake access and is surrounded by rolling meadows and forests. Guests will find pitches for motorhomes, tents, and fixed rental accommodations. Amenities include sanitary facilities, a small shop, and a lakeside restaurant. The village of Petting itself features a public lido area and serves as a premier gateway for hikes in the Rupertiwinkel.
